_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for all tunable scoring numbers. Edit here only. The SKILL.md reference and the scorecard script both read from this file. Raw points are relative; they are normalized to sum to 100 at runtime, so you can change any number without recalculating the others.

_low_activity_industries_comment: Reviewer verticals that engage poorly with G2 regardless of user job type. Business-maintained; grows over time. Used by the Customer industry input: if the #1 reviewer vertical is on this list, that input floors at 15 AND the final score is multiplied by low_activity_top1_penalty. Match on survey_responses.industry_name.
